title: Late-Delivery Make-Good Rate Card: Amount by Calendar Days Late
content:
Delivery Claims rate card for the lateness amount of the late-delivery make-good on a Late Delivery Claim.

**Rate.** The lateness amount of the make-good depends on how many calendar days the delivered date fell after the promised delivery date: a delivery 4 or more calendar days late accrues 4.00 USD for each calendar day late; a delivery 2 or 3 calendar days late pays the claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount times 1.5; any other delivery pays the claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount.

The days are calendar days from the order's promised delivery date to its delivered date, both as recorded on the order. The claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount is the figure the Delivery Claims late delivery terms set for the Late Delivery Claim.

| Calendar days late | Lateness amount |
|---|---|
| 1 or fewer | the claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount, as it stands |
| 2 or 3 | the claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount times 1.5 |
| 4 or more | 4.00 USD for each calendar day late |

## Band edges

- 1 day late: the late-delivery goodwill amount. 2 days late: 1.5 times it. The step falls between 1 and 2.
- 3 days late: 1.5 times the late-delivery goodwill amount. 4 days late: 4.00 USD for each of the 4 days, 16.00 USD. The step falls between 3 and 4.
- In the top band the per-day figure replaces the late-delivery goodwill amount; it is not added to it.

## Per-day band figures

| Calendar days late | Lateness amount |
|---|---|
| 4 | 16.00 USD |
| 5 | 20.00 USD |
| 7 | 28.00 USD |
| 10 | 40.00 USD |
